$comment: Internal (non-MCP) action records for console visibility. MCP tools are auto-discovered from servers and need no seeding.

tools.name: Validate Output Schema
tools.description: Validates composer JSON output against the agent's output schema; drives the bounded retry loop on invalid output.

tools.name: Citation Parser
tools.description: Extracts [kc:slug#anchor] citations from model output, resolves them against the knowledge index, flags unresolvable anchors as warnings.

tools.name: Untrusted Input Sanitiser
tools.description: Strips active content from uploads, wraps user-provided context in <untrusted> delimiters before prompt assembly.

tools.name: Run Telemetry Logger
tools.description: Persists ordered step traces, token counts, cost and latency to playground_runs and llm_call_records.
